# @three-ws/agent-vitals

> Capability attestation for autonomous agents. Not "is it up" but "can it act": model an agent's preconditions as a causal graph, get back the root blocker and the command that fixes it.

@three-ws/agent-vitals is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/agent-vitals`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-vitals/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-vitals/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agent-vitals/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agent-vitals/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
